shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing an armchair near the bookcase end. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the doorway-side sofa seat and recounts the dances from the evening ball, a man in a white shirt sits in the bookcase-side sofa seat, and a woman in a blue shirt sits in the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: The man in a white shirt asks to skip the list of dance partners, but the woman in an orange shirt explains the success of the evening.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two sofa seats.

shots.content: The woman in an orange shirt lists the remaining dance partners from the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the coffee-table side, centered on the person at the doorway-side sofa seat.

shots.content: The man in a white shirt objects to hearing more details, but the woman in an orange shirt continues recounting the evening dances.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the coffee table.
